description: GreenGlobe Agri Venture Pvt Ltd is implementing a project activity that promotes 'Alternate Wetting and Drying' (AWD) and related adjusted water management practices in irrigated lowland rice systems across five selected districts viz. Bhopal, Narmadapuram, Raisen, Sehore and Vidisha, of the state Madhya Pradesh in India. The project activity reduces methane (CH₄) emissions from soil methanogenesis by shifting from continuous flooding to intermittent irrigation, while supporting farmers through training, technical guidance and provision of field water monitoring tools. The project will support farmers through awareness programs, technical training, and the provision of field water tubes to monitor soil water levels, enabling consistent application of AWD. The project is designed as a single project activity with phase-wise implementation of the project activity within a defined geographic boundary. As per the design of the project, the cumulative capacity of the project will be about 43,813 ha, expected to generate average annual GHG emission reductions of approximately 66,905 tCO2e, and approximately 535,243 tCO2e over the initial seven-year crediting period. Project also intends to promote use of direct seeded rice (DSR). Thus, the measure consists of AWD method or AWD in combination with and/or DSR in combination with adjusted water management system in rice cultivation. Overall, the project activity contributes to both climate change mitigation initiatives and social sustainability by means of SDGs.
